freeze_statement: This ledger and all referenced pre-classical bridge artifacts were hashed before R052 Stage-F/classical identification was opened. No post-opening bridge repair is permitted.

new_statements.proof_core: R1 h is a fixed-point-free involution: in C_m it is translation by m/2; its orbits therefore all have size two. Orbit quotient is definable and the deck is unique.
new_statements.statement: Every even-boundary R1 instance canonically defines an exact two-sheet orbit cover q_h:B->B/<h_B>, whose unique deck transformation is h_B.

new_statements.proof_core: Frozen T-E1 gives i h_m=h_km i; hence [j]->[i(j)] is well-defined on orbit quotients and q_km i=bar_i q_m.
new_statements.statement: Frozen uniform refinements induce morphisms of R1 orbit covers and commute with the deck involutions.

new_statements.proof_core: Whenever a cross-cover isomorphism phi exists, postcomposition by the nontrivial target deck gives a distinct isomorphism; naturality under target automorphisms forbids selecting phi canonically.
new_statements.statement: The canonical R1 and R2 functors into COVER2 do not supply a canonical cross-identification of their cover objects.

new_statements.proof_core: Lift shift changes coefficient by 2m; generator inversion changes sign. Even parity yields order-two section and Z⊕C2; odd parity yields a generator y of L with 2y generating K, hence L≅Z.
new_statements.statement: Abelian S6-compatible extensions 0->Z->L->C2->0 have exactly two isomorphism classes, split and non-split, classified by parity of 2x relative to a kernel generator.

new_statements.proof_core: Immediate from the two extension normal forms.
new_statements.statement: Under S6, a lift x of z with 2x generating K exists iff the extension is non-split iff there is no order-two lift of z iff L is torsion-free.
Frozen S6 does not force any half-lift whose double generates the kernel.

new_statements.proof_core: Primitive lifts form inverse pair ±y; quotient is singleton. Doubling sends ±y to ±2y, the kernel-generator inversion orbit. Both representatives project to z.
new_statements.statement: S6 plus the non-split axiom canonically yields one orientation-free primitive half-lift class; doubling bijects it to R5, while projection/action sends it to R3.

new_statements.proof_core: B-M2 is an S6 model satisfying all frozen axioms but lacking primitive half-lifts.
new_statements.statement: Deleting the non-split extension-class axiom destroys the half/full coherence theorem.

new_statements.proof_core: Combine T-C4 with frozen R052 T-D2.
new_statements.statement: In S6+BEX3, the exact canonical non-scalar component is a span Half(p)->R5 and Half(p)->R3, with frozen R3=R2 in the S4/A* realization; no R3=R5 equality is asserted.

new_statements.proof_core: Each polygon perimeter scales by a and the ratio is squared in perimeter.
new_statements.statement: For R4, N->aN with a>0 and mu fixed sends J->a^2 J.
For R4, mu->c mu sends J->J/c.

new_statements.proof_core: Group homomorphism and generator class are unchanged; absolute scalar image is homogeneous.
new_statements.statement: For any declared kernel scalarizer lambda, lambda->b lambda with b>0 leaves R5 unchanged and rescales its scalar magnitude readout by b.

new_statements.proof_core: Combine independent norm, valuation, and scalarizer rescaling models.
new_statements.statement: In the common S5+S6 comparison language with a kernel scalarizer, (a,c,b) acts by J->a^2 J/c and P->bP. Therefore the frozen non-scalar data do not force a scalar equality or fixed ratio without independent normalization.
